expert_audit.limits: Companion visualization files are supplementary references. No frame-by-frame provenance from those 28-D files to the consumed 22-D AMP files was verified. Root attitude is not a direct field in the 22-D AMP frame. Raw Euler averages were not used; orientations were converted using the replay script xyz convention.

method.windows: Half-open post-step telemetry times. Movement statistics and periodicity use 5<=t<15 seconds.
method.angles: Roll atan2(-gy,-gz); backward lean asin(-gx); tilt acos(-gz/||g||). Gravity checked independently against quaternion.
method.frequency: Hann FFT with 0.1Hz resolution. Harmonic fit uses intercept plus sine/cosine at 1.25Hz multiples 1..8, reports in-sample variance explained; not a causal test.
method.phase_plot: Time modulo configured 0.8s gait period; phase not separately recorded; labels describe alignment only, not measured foot contact.
method.action_mapping: Raw actions use configured preserve_order list; physical joint arrays use telemetry joint_names.
method.reward_reconstruction: Only posture (-8*||g_xy||^2) and hip L1 raw-action (-1) terms reconstructed before dt=.02 and task mix=.3. Full task/AMP contributions not reconstructed.

findings: Right-turn roll bias develops after command starts at2s and recovers after stop15s. Initial first100 states and actions match all scenarios exactly.
Right-turn roll is correlated with hip coordinates; no torque saturation supports a hip actuator ceiling explanation. Correlation does not establish which signal causes which.
Right-turn hip L1 action cost is smaller than left-turn despite larger posture error; minimizing raw hip actions is not equivalent to minimizing body tilt.
Backward and moving-turn pitch contain strong gait-frequency/harmonic structure. Foot contact or support-switching cause cannot be confirmed without contact telemetry.
limitations: Single seed, one checkpoint. Identical startup does not exclude direction-dependent sensitivity to the same asymmetric randomized dynamics.
Actual COM offsets, gains, per-joint delays, calibrated default positions, foot contact forces and foot positions are not in this telemetry.
No new simulation, training, export or parameter edit.
